label: Louis XII of France
summary: King of France whose conquest of Milan in 1499 ended Leonardo's first Milanese period, and who later claimed him as his painter.

sources.cite: Standard reference works. Model recall, not checked in this session.

claims.statement: Died in Paris. Leonardo's note on Giuliano de' Medici's departure of 9 January 1515 also mentions the death of the King of France.
